experimental_question: Can a local model reconstruct a cross-service configuration incident under an explicitly visible and fully aligned evaluation contract?

construct_validity.intended_construct: Source-grounded multi-file incident diagnosis under bounded selective file access.
construct_validity.v05_alignment_change: Preserve validated temporal, evidence-role and normalization behavior while exposing exact scope IDs, defining evidence_ids as the sole attached-evidence field and replacing negation-blind prose matching with controlled-code integrity.
known_blind_spots: deterministic checks do not fully judge prose quality
the v0.5 representation reuses the exact historical evidence fixture

reporting_limits: v0.5 is a new representation of an existing incident, not an independent task.
Do not pool v0.2, v0.3, v0.4 and v0.5 attempts as repeated observations.
Free-text source grounding requires a separate human or fixed-judge calibration and is not inferred from substrings.
Normalized semantic success and strict transport compliance must remain separate.
Capability Sweep evidence does not estimate reliability or latency tails.
